facts.value: Completion of level A1 of the GER or 40 – 60 points in the placement test.

In the course 'Spanish for Business 1 - Base', you will learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. You will gain extensive knowledge of the Spanish language, as well as insights into the country, its society, and topics related to business life, such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends. A variety of exercises will also promote linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics and lay the foundation for discussions and written exercises on various economic subjects.
Oral participation and presentation, written examination in the last lecture week. A graded certificate will be issued for successful completion of the examinations.
